notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB138): all four measured defects closed. (a) The 14.6.13.1.4 NONFATAL DISPATCH exists - the runtime REPORTS the GR1b raise (a bool) and the emitted site runs the USE-declarative selection with RESUME honored; the golden's handler prints BOTH its lines and execution resumes, where the old site recorded the status and the generated handler pc was dead code. (c) The m=0 truncation runs in the interval's OWN domain: since kb/Work PB1529 the runtime takes the sign and the whole seconds from the exact value on each carrier (CobolTiming.ContinueAfter overloads over Int128+scale, UInt128+scale, CobolDec and binary64; saturating through CobolNum.PositionOf), so 0.99999999999999999 - whose binary64 image is exactly 1.0 - suspends zero seconds (GR1's implicit COMPUTE without ROUNDED), a fractional (-1,0) still raises on its exact sign, and a value above the maximum meaningful value suspends for the maximum on every carrier. (d) DeclIsTrivialExit no longer classifies CONTINUE AFTER - a SUSPENSION - as a pure exit point, so a USE handler's bounded dispatch is not truncated mid-handler.
